components.note: 力 (strength) — effort, as in 办, 助, 努: achievement takes effort.
工 (gōng) gives the exact sound; 工 also means work.
耂 (old) — shown in 老 old and 者; 考 first meant an aged person (the same word as 老), then to examine.
丂 (kǎo) gives the sound; also in 巧 qiǎo, 烤 kǎo and 拷 kǎo.
心 (heart) — thought and feelings, as in 想, 思, 感: 虑 is to turn something over in the mind.
才 (talent, just) — a sprout pushing out of the ground. 才 also sounds out 材 cái and 财 cái.
纟 (silk thread, simplified 糸) — threads and binding, as in 红, 给, 经: an agreement binds like a cord.
勺 (sháo) is a loose sound clue for yuē; 勺 also in 药 yào and 钓 diào.
艹 stands in for 竹 (bamboo) in the traditional 節, bamboo joints: sections, then festivals and knots.
目 (eye) — an eye turned on its side. As a radical it marks sight: 看 look, 眼 eye, 睡 sleep, 盯 stare.
辶 (walk) — movement and roads, as in 过, 近, 送: a way through.
甬 (yǒng) is a close sound clue for tōng; 甬 also in 痛 tòng, 桶 tǒng and 勇 yǒng.
母 (mother) — a woman 女 with two dots for breasts: a nursing mother. 母 also appears in 每 měi, 海 hǎi and 梅 méi.
主 (master, host) — a lamp with a flame on top; a lamp stand was the centre of the room. 主 also sounds out 注 zhù, 住 zhù and 柱 zhù.
又 (hand) — a hand stretched with a measuring rule: 丈 is a unit of length (ten 尺), and in 丈夫 the old word for "husband".
大 (person) — a man with a hairpin 一 on his head, a grown man; 夫 also gives 扶 fú and 肤 fū.
釆 (distinguish) — sorting things out: 释 is to untangle and explain.
圣 stands in for 睪 in the traditional 釋; the same part is in 译 yì, 泽 zé and 择 zé.
耳 (ear) — hearing and joining, as in 听, 聪, 闻: 联 first meant ears joined, so to link. The part 关 stands in for the traditional shape.
口 (mouth) — speech, as in 吃, 唱, 问: an order is spoken.
令 (lìng, order) is a close sound clue for mìng; 令 also in 领 lǐng, 冷 lěng and 零 líng.
宀 (roof) — houses and shelter, as in 家, 安, 字: a room under the roof.
至 (zhì, arrive) is a loose sound clue for shì; it fits the meaning: where one arrives inside the house.
隹 (zhuī, short-tailed bird) — 难 was first the name of a bird; "hard" is a borrowed use. The 又 here stands in for the traditional left part.
奇 (qí) is a sound clue for 骑 qí, 寄 jì, 椅 yǐ and 崎 qí; as a word it means strange or remarkable.
忄 (heart) — feelings, as in 快, 忙, 情: a strange feeling.
圣 here is not the "sage" word; it is only a loose sound clue for guài.
木 (tree) — wood, as in 树, 林, 桌: 极 first meant a roof beam, the very top.
及 (jí) gives the exact sound; also in 级 jí and 吸 xī.
口 (mouth) — speech, as in 吃, 唱, 问: voices in unison. 同 also gives sound to 铜 tóng, 桶 tǒng, 洞 dòng.
氵 (water) — water and swimming, as in 河, 海, 泳: swimming and drifting.
斿 (yóu) gives the exact sound: a flag with streamers that floats freely.
戈 (halberd) — weapons, as in 战 war and 成; the traditional 戲 was a play or contest.
忄 (heart) — feelings, as in 快, 怕, 情: a heart with no rest.
亡 (wáng) is a close sound clue for máng; 亡 also in 忘 wàng, 望 wàng and 盲 máng.
危 (danger) — a person at the top of a cliff, with another person kneeling below: a precarious spot.
阝 on the left is 阜 (mound, hill) — as in 院, 阳, 阴: a steep place, a risky pass.
佥 (qiān) is a loose sound clue for xiǎn; 佥 also in 检 jiǎn, 剑 jiàn, 脸 liǎn and 验 yàn.
讠 (speech) — words and language, as in 说, 请, 谢: to ask or discuss.
曾 (céng) began as a picture of a steamer (甑 zèng adds 瓦); the past-time meaning is borrowed. 曾 also gives 增 zēng, 层 céng and 赠 zèng.
目 (eye) — sight, as in 看, 睛, 睡.
艮 (gèn) is a loose sound clue for yǎn; 艮 also sounds out 跟 gēn, 很 hěn and 根 gēn.
目 (eye) — sight, as in 看, 眼, 睡.
青 (qīng) is a close sound clue for jīng; 青 also in 清, 请, 情 and 晴.
纟 (silk thread, simplified 糸) — threads and links, as in 红, 经, 系: thread gathered into one.
充 (chōng) is only a loose sound clue for tǒng.
亻 (person) — people, as in 你, 他, 做: a person hurt. The traditional 傷 took its sound from 昜 yáng (also in 汤 and 场).
扌 (hand) — hand actions, as in 打, 拿, 抱: holding the reins.
空 (kōng) is a close sound clue for kòng; 空 also in 腔 qiāng and 孔 kǒng.
刂 (knife) — cutting, as in 到, 分, 别: 制 is cutting to shape, then to make and to control.
辶 (walk) — movement, as in 过, 远, 送: coming closer.
斤 (jīn) is a close sound clue for jìn.
音 (sound) — 言 (speech) with a stroke inside the mouth: a note within speech. 音 also gives 意 yì and 暗 àn.
忄 (heart) — feelings, as in 怕, 忙, 情: a quick, glad heart.
夬 (guài) is a close sound clue for kuài; 夬 also in 块 kuài, 筷 kuài and 决 jué.
乐 (music, joy) — simplified from 樂, a stringed instrument on a wooden stand. Read yuè "music" or lè "joy".
入 (enter) — a pointed shape pushing in; not 人 (person), whose strokes spread outward.
句 (jù, sentence) is a close sound clue for gòu; also in 构 gòu, 沟 gōu and 钩 gōu.
多 (many) — meaning "more than enough".
日 (sun) — time and day, as in 时, 晚, 明: 昨 is a past day.
乍 (zhà) is a close sound clue for zuó; 乍 also in 作 zuò, 怎 zěn and 炸 zhà.
阝 on the left is 阜 (mound) — as in 险, 阳, 阴: a walled yard.
完 (wán) is a close sound clue for yuàn; also in 玩 wán.
走 (walk, run) — movement, as in 起, 越, 赶: going toward something that attracts you.
取 (qǔ) is a close sound clue for qù; 取 also in 娶 qǔ and 聚 jù.
木 (tree) — 杰 is simplified from 傑; a tall tree makes a handy picture for an outstanding person standing tall.
阝 on the right is 邑 (city) — places, as in 都 capital, 邮 post, 那: a district or ministry.
咅 (pǒu) is a loose sound clue for bù; 咅 also in 剖 pōu, 培 péi and 陪 péi.
